question: If I cast a spell that is both an artifact and an instant, does prowess trigger twice?

expected.shortAnswer: No: prowess triggers only once for any spell, even if the spell has multiple types.
expected.answer: Prowess triggers only once for any spell, even if that spell has multiple types.
